papers.title: Castle visitor's book
lines: Visited with the children. They fought the dragons and lost. The dragons won on points.
The view is of the sea and the mountains and, below, a very small train.

trail.clue: A guide hid his tips near the big rock. 'For the day it rains on the whole of Wales.'

papers.title: Dance card, 1952
lines: Seafront dance, seven till eleven. Last waltz for those with someone to walk home.
I kept it in my pocket for forty years. He did walk me home. He still does.

papers.title: Lifeboat log
lines: Launch at 2.14 in a Force 9. Crew of seven. Returned 5.40 with two fishermen and a goat.
The goat was not on the shout list. The goat was not asked.

papers.title: Railway ticket
lines: One ticket to the top of Constitution Hill, in a car the shape of a shoebox.
From the top you can see Cardigan Bay, and, on a clear day, the next ticket.
